PC: Obtain accurate history including tetanus status, prior envenomation and allergies
Perform appropriate first aid: remove jewelry, clean and wash bite, keep extremity at level of the heart
Pain control with narcotics while being mindful of hypotension
Measure circumference of affected extremity on presentation and repeat every 15-30 minutes initially
Order CBC, chemistry, PT, PTT, fibrinogen or d-dimer, type & screen, CK
Do not attempt to incise and drain wound
Do not perform or recommend a fasciotomy
SBP: Once patient is stabilized, transfer/handoff to Critical Care team
